title: Tiny, cute teapot
svg:
<svg viewBox='0 0 100 100' xmlns='http://www.w3.org/2000/svg'>
  <defs>
    <radialGradient id='potGrad' cx='40%' cy='35%' r='60%'>
      <stop offset='0%' stop-color='#7ddf7d'/>
      <stop offset='100%' stop-color='#3aa63a'/>
    </radialGradient>
    <radialGradient id='lidGrad' cx='50%' cy='30%' r='60%'>
      <stop offset='0%' stop-color='#b8f0b8'/>
      <stop offset='100%' stop-color='#4cc84c'/>
    </radialGradient>
    <radialGradient id='knobGrad' cx='40%' cy='30%' r='60%'>
      <stop offset='0%' stop-color='#ff9d5c'/>
      <stop offset='100%' stop-color='#d44a0a'/>
    </radialGradient>
  </defs>

  <!-- shadow -->
  <ellipse cx='50' cy='86' rx='30' ry='5' fill='#2a4a5a' opacity='0.35'/>

  <!-- handle -->
  <path d='M73 46 C90 44 92 64 72 66' fill='none' stroke='#4cc84c' stroke-width='6' stroke-linecap='round'/>

  <!-- spout -->
  <path d='M28 50 C14 46 10 36 12 26' fill='none' stroke='#4cc84c' stroke-width='7' stroke-linecap='round'/>
  <ellipse cx='12' cy='26' rx='4.5' ry='3' fill='#7ddf7d'/>

  <!-- body -->
  <ellipse cx='50' cy='60' rx='26' ry='22' fill='url(#potGrad)'/>
  <ellipse cx='43' cy='52' rx='10' ry='7' fill='#a7efa7' opacity='0.55'/>

  <!-- shoulder band -->
  <path d='M26 48 Q50 42 74 48' fill='none' stroke='#b8f0b8' stroke-width='2.5' opacity='0.7'/>

  <!-- lid -->
  <ellipse cx='50' cy='39' rx='19' ry='6' fill='url(#lidGrad)'/>
  <ellipse cx='50' cy='38.5' rx='15' ry='4' fill='#d9fad9' opacity='0.4'/>

  <!-- knob -->
  <circle cx='50' cy='31' r='5' fill='url(#knobGrad)'/>
  <circle cx='48.5' cy='29.5' r='1.8' fill='#ffd4b3' opacity='0.8'/>

  <!-- base -->
  <ellipse cx='50' cy='80' rx='18' ry='4' fill='#2e8a2e'/>

  <!-- cute face -->
  <circle cx='42' cy='58' r='3' fill='#ffffff'/>
  <circle cx='58' cy='58' r='3' fill='#ffffff'/>
  <circle cx='42.5' cy='58.5' r='1.6' fill='#1a1a3a'/>
  <circle cx='58.5' cy='58.5' r='1.6' fill='#1a1a3a'/>
  <circle cx='43' cy='57.5' r='0.6' fill='#ffffff'/>
  <circle cx='59' cy='57.5' r='0.6' fill='#ffffff'/>

  <!-- blush -->
  <ellipse cx='36' cy='64' rx='4' ry='2.5' fill='#ff88aa' opacity='0.65'/>
  <ellipse cx='64' cy='64' rx='4' ry='2.5' fill='#ff88aa' opacity='0.65'/>

  <!-- smile -->
  <path d='M46 66 Q50 70 54 66' fill='none' stroke='#1a5a1a' stroke-width='1.8' stroke-linecap='round'/>
</svg>
